When the description says that after work is sent to another party, the process repeatedly asks for changes until the work is accepted, so the next activity depends on whether the returned work is accepted: Model the returned work as a receive element placed after the sending activity. Place an exclusive gateway after that receive element with one outgoing flow for 'accepted', which continues the process, and one for 'not accepted', which returns to the activity that requests changes, forming a revision loop. Do not add parallel gateways unless the description requires concurrent or synchronized branches.
